_: Vilas 0.5.1 — gestos dos aldeões (100% nosso). Somas no FIM das animações do Fresh Animations, lidas das variáveis do mod Vilas: tvilas_gesture (1 acenar, 2 festejar, 3 encolher os ombros, 4 sim, 5 não, 6 apontar, 7 bater palmas, 8 martelar, 9 comer) e tvilas_gesture_time (0..1). Os mesmos números que o gancho do mod (GestureRules.deltas): rx negativo levanta os braços, ty negativo sobe.
arms.rx: arms.rx -if(tvilas_gesture == 1, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*2.4, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 2, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*2.6, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 3, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*0.4, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 6, (sin(min(tvilas_gesture_time*4, 1)*pi/2)*min(1, (1-tvilas_gesture_time)*6))*1.6, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 7, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*1.4, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 8, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*(1+max(0, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi*6))*1.4), 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 9, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*1.6, 0)
arms.ty: arms.ty -if(tvilas_gesture == 1, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*3, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 2, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*3, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 3, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*4, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 6, (sin(min(tvilas_gesture_time*4, 1)*pi/2)*min(1, (1-tvilas_gesture_time)*6))*2, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 9, sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi)*2, 0) -if(tvilas_gesture == 2, abs(sin(tvilas_gesture_time*pi*2))*4, 0)
